# Romeing

> > Your insider guide to Rome's historic sites, cultural experiences, dining, and authentic local living.

Romeing is a comprehensive travel and culture resource for Rome, covering ancient landmarks like the Baths of Caracalla and Castel Sant'Angelo, museums, art by masters like Antonio Canova, dining experiences from Michelin-starred restaurants to local pasticcerie, unique accommodations, and cultural events including the Roma Jazz Festival. The site blends practical visitor information with insider perspectives on Roman life.

## Key Topics

- Ancient Rome & Roman Architecture
- Baths of Caracalla & Roman Thermae
- Castel Sant'Angelo
- Vatican & St. Peter's Basilica
- Antonio Canova Sculptures
- Roma Jazz Festival & Music Events
- Fine Dining & Michelin-starred Restaurants
- Pasticcerie & Roman Bakeries
- Historic Sites & Archaeological Tours
- Tiber River & Riverside Activities
- Museums & Contemporary Art (MACRO)
- Alternative Rome Tours (Vespa, Bike, Tram)
- Convent Stays & Unique Accommodations
- Ostia Beach & Day Trips
- Rome Nightlife & Cultural Events

## Historic Sites & Ancient Rome

- [Visit Castel Sant'Angelo, Rome's Castle over the Tiber River](https://www.romeing.it/castel-santangelo): Castel Sant'Angelo guide: Hadrian's Mausoleum & Vatican fortress history
- [Visit the Baths of Caracalla in Rome | Romeing](https://www.romeing.it/baths-of-caracalla-rome): Guide to Baths of Caracalla: history, 4D tours, tickets & visiting hours
- [The Order of Malta Keyhole - Romeing](https://www.romeing.it/the-order-of-malta-keyhole): Order of Malta keyhole on Aventine Hill: St. Peter's dome view

## Arts & Museums

- [Antonio Canova's artworks in Rome | Romeing](https://www.romeing.it/antonio-canova-rome-artworks): Guide to Antonio Canova's neoclassical sculptures & artworks in Rome
- [Museum Hendrik Christian Andersen in Rome | Romeing](https://www.romeing.it/museum-hendrik-christian-andersen-rome): Hendrik Christian Andersen Museum: Liberty villa in Flaminio, free entry
- [MACRO – Museum for Preventive Imagination - Romeing](https://www.romeing.it/macro-museum-for-preventive-imagination): MACRO's Museum for Preventive Imagination project by Luca Lo Pinto

## Food & Dining

- [Rome Pasticcerie and Bakery Guide - Romeing](https://www.romeing.it/best-pasticcerie-bakery-rome): Best pasticcerie, pastry shops & bakeries in Rome including Testaccio
- [An Interview with a Michelin-starred Chef, Heinz Beck - Romeing](https://www.romeing.it/heinz-beck-interview): Interview with Michelin-starred chef Heinz Beck of La Pergola

## Music & Cultural Events

- [The 2025 Roma Jazz Festival: 1 - 23 November 2024](https://www.romeing.it/roma-jazz-festival): Roma Jazz Festival 2025 at Auditorium Parco della Musica & venues
- [TramJazz - Romeing](https://www.romeing.it/tram-jazz-rome): TramJazz: candlelit dinner with live jazz on historic Rome tram tour
- [TeverEstate: Dolce Vita by the river - Romeing](https://www.romeing.it/teverestate-dolce-vita-by-the-river): TeverEstate summer events: riverside dining & nightlife along Tiber

## Tours & Alternative Experiences

- [Alternative modes of tour in Rome - Romeing](https://www.romeing.it/alternative-modes-tour-rome): Alternative Rome tours: Vespa, Ape car, scooter & boat sightseeing
- [Two Wheels to Freedom](https://www.romeing.it/two-wheels-to-freedom): Complete guide to biking in Rome: trails, tours, rentals & bike lanes
- [Under The Summer Sun: A Day Trip To Ostia - Romeing](https://www.romeing.it/day-trip-to-ostia): Day trip guide to Ostia beach & Ostia Antica archaeological site

## Accommodations & Stays

- [Monasteries and Convent Stays in Rome - Romeing](https://www.romeing.it/convent-stays-in-rome): Best monastery & convent accommodation in Rome for all budgets
- [Hotel De La Ville: a gem atop the Spanish Steps - Romeing](https://www.romeing.it/hotel-de-la-ville-rome): Hotel De La Ville review: Rocco Forte luxury hotel at Spanish Steps
- [The Sanctuary Eco Retreat - Romeing](https://www.romeing.it/the-sanctuary-eco-retreat-rome): The Sanctuary eco retreat: yoga, wellness, cocktails on Caelian Hill

## Optional

- [Is Italy a Man-Free Dream? - Romeing](https://www.romeing.it/is-italy-a-man-free-dream): Expat perspective on gender differences & cultural life in Italy
- [Procida è Capitale Italiana della Cultura 2022 - Romeing](https://www.romeing.it/it/capitale-italiana-della-cultura-2022): Procida named Italian Capital of Culture 2022 (Italian language)
- [Iconico e intramontabile, lo smoking oggi - Romeing](https://www.romeing.it/it/iconico-e-intramontabile-lo-smoking-oggi): History & etiquette of the tuxedo/smoking jacket (Italian language)
